server_policy: Do not rent, connect to, build on, or run a GPU server until local decision gates pass and remaining validation scope is reviewed.
primary_protocol: P4 leave original M/N group out; identical to previous comparison
stress_protocol: P4 leave K value out; diagnostic, no model selection
feature_interpretation: Kernel geometry interactions, not measured occupancy or a physical latency law. Exact q=1 zero reference retained.
unchanged: historical measured labels and source identities

local_readiness_gate.priority_shapes: No host choice when the observed best eligible fused candidate is at least 5% faster; retrospective regression check only
local_readiness_gate.interpretation: Passing permits discussion of minimal hardware validation, not compiler admission or proof of independent generalization
local_readiness_gate.on_failure: keep server work blocked; retain failures and do not change thresholds after seeing results

audit: exact feature collisions and measured label spread
counterfactual replacement of gate/split/group with observed ratios, diagnosis only
score inputs contain no measured latency
